user_amendment: 448x448 preprocess; disk pooled 2x2 = 256 FP16 tokens; load pooled 2x2 = 64 tokens; optional 256-token timing/VRAM if budget remains
optional_256_tokens: timing/VRAM only after primary arms and generation, budget permitting
data_policy: local-only; no MIMIC data in external calls or terminal output

preflight_assumptions.bce: 14 synthetic zero labels, weight 0.1; execution only; P4 labeler outputs do not cover 2000 training references
preflight_assumptions.optional_256_arm: LoRA rank16, batch1, 3 optimizer steps, no generation or quality assessment
